selected_editorial_cases.headline: Trump, major AI companies sign voluntary White House accord on external and internal AI safety reviews

editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.new_development: Within this window, the White House moved from general AI-safety debate to a signed voluntary accord involving multiple major firms.
editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.affected_listener: People tracking AI regulation, enterprise deployment, and safety governance are affected because this could shape future oversight norms.
editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.why_today: It is one of the clearest public policy developments in the window and affects multiple frontier AI institutions at once.
editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.distinct_question: What did the White House get major AI companies to sign, and does it signal real oversight or just symbolism?
editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.new_since_prior_coverage: New formal agreement at the White House; earlier coverage was debate and proposed restraint, not a signed accord.
editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.practical_payoff: Watch whether the voluntary reviews turn into enforceable rules or procurement/safety requirements.

selected_editorial_cases.headline: OpenAI unveils always-on 'Dot' agents after shelving a more advanced model over safety concerns

editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.new_development: OpenAI added a new always-on agent product while separately delaying another model over safety issues.
editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.affected_listener: Developers, workplace users, and consumers who may rely on autonomous AI assistants are directly affected.
editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.why_today: It is a major product announcement from a top lab and directly answers what OpenAI is shipping now versus holding back.
editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.distinct_question: What exactly did OpenAI launch, and what did it decide not to launch?
editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.new_since_prior_coverage: New agent launch plus a new safety-related postponement in the same reporting window.
editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.practical_payoff: Track whether Dot becomes a real consumer/workflow assistant and whether the delayed model returns after additional safety work.

editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.distinct_question: Did safety testing actually block a major OpenAI release?
